When this is on, MeloX reads play counts, completion, skips, likes, and source preferences on this device to train and run a lightweight recommendation model. That data is not uploaded. MeloX does not read passwords, cookies, messages, or raw microphone audio. You can withdraw consent and delete the model data at any time.
This removes the on-device model, song features, recommendation index, analysis progress, and privacy consent. Service sign-in, original play history, and favorites are kept.

Only when NetEase explicitly returns no playable audio, MeloX looks for a full match on QQ Music, Kugou, or Bilibili.
Only when NetEase explicitly can\'t return a full playable track, MeloX sends the current title, artist, and duration to the search APIs of QQ Music, Kugou, and Bilibili.

Only a full track whose title and main artist match, and whose duration is within a strict range, will play. MeloX does not use previews and does not bypass paid, region, copyright, DRM, or account limits. The service, version, and quality may differ from the original entry. Likes, playlist identity, and lyrics stay on the original NetEase item.
